department: Department of Civil and Coastal Engineering (ESSIE)

deadline.value: December 5 priority deadline for Fall applicants

gre_general.value: GRE or FE verifications are not required for PhD applicants.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Records Examination (GRE) or Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) verifications are not required for master-level/Ph.D. applicants.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Civil Engineering subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Contacting faculty is not required for application submission, but applicants are encouraged to contact faculty to discuss research and funding.
supervisor.quote: Statement of Purpose: Please indicate the faculty who you are interested in working with and if you have secured any outside funding in this statement.

funding.value: Funding is awarded by individual faculty members based on educational background and research experience.
funding.quote: Most entering graduate students are initially supported by a teaching assistantship, which pays the student’s tuition and provides a stipend.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from bachelor's degree with upper-division GPA of at least 3.0.
entry_route.quote: For applicants with solely a bachelor’s degree, a minimum 3.0 GPA on all coursework completed after the applicant has earned 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) is required.
